request_profiles.description: Preserve the exact user-selected gateway effort, including explicit none, after protocol conversion.
Map the selected effort to Anthropic adaptive thinking and output_config.effort; none disables thinking.

tool_targets.description: Generate one image with GPT Image 2 through the OpenDesign Link image endpoint.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to let the model's default profile decide.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier; send only together with aspect_ratio and only when the user asked for a size, because tiers are priced differently. Plan caps enforced by OpenDesign: Plus up to 1K, Pro and Max up to 2K; Go has no image entitlement.

quality.description: Priced quality tier; send only when the user asked for one, otherwise the model's cheapest default tier applies.

extension_profile.summary: Generate a new image with GPT Image 2. OpenDesign's default image model; the only one with quality tiers.
characteristics: Parameters follow the OpenDesign media contract: aspect_ratio, resolution and quality.
Omitted aspect_ratio, resolution and quality leave the server's default profile and price in charge.
constraints: Exactly one image is generated per call.
Plan caps enforced by OpenDesign: Plus up to 1K, Pro and Max up to 2K; Go has no image entitlement.
The target is available only while the credential's plan-filtered catalog lists the model.
quality accepts low, medium or high.
limitations: Declared from the OpenDesign source and plan rules; no successful generation has been observed yet.
Reference-image editing is not exposed: the Link host has no /images/edits route.

sources.note: Credential-scoped catalog, exact model IDs, input modalities, context_limit and output_budget verified on 2026-10-14 and re-read on 2026-11-07: the plain catalog lists only the plan-entitled models (14 on Go) while ?all=true lists every model. Video claims are excluded from executable capabilities after unsuccessful Chat media probes.
Design Plan shared quota, subscription windows and API usage policy.

Sanitized live protocol, reasoning, media and source evidence; ineffective reasoning controls are explicit. Hy4 Preview was absent on 2026-10-14 and is declared from the 2026-11-07 catalog and probes.

Sanitized 2026-11-07 Go-key catalog and Chat probes for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco, Hy4 Preview and MiniMax M3.1 Flash: catalog limits, accepted effort labels, explicit none, and strict json_schema with an unprompted enum marker.

2026-10-31 live Chat response_format json_schema probes: an unprompted enum-only marker field was reproduced by every DeepSeek model, and strict schemas with partial required lists were accepted. 2026-11-07 live Chat probes on a Go key: reasoning_effort none per model, every effort label for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco, Hy4 Preview and MiniMax M3.1 Flash, and strict json_schema with an unprompted enum marker field.

2026-11-07 live probes: GPT-6 Luna text, streaming, function calls, strict json_schema, image and PDF input on Responses; reasoning.effort none, low, medium and high are echoed, minimal, xhigh and max fall back to medium. Anthropic Messages at /v1/messages accepts Bearer and x-api-key; Claude Haiku 5.5 text, streaming, tool use, output_config json_schema, image and PDF input pass, adaptive thinking with output_config.effort yields thinking blocks and an unknown effort is rejected. Both routes also accept other families, but only GPT uses Responses and only Claude uses Messages.

OpenDesign client media contract at commit 87a4f91c30: image models gpt-image-2, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-2-lite, seedream-5.0 and seedream-5.0-pro take aspect_ratio (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4), a published resolution tier and, for gpt-image-2 only, quality low/medium/high; omitted values keep the server default and price. Resolution caps per plan follow the official plan table (Plus 1K, Pro 2K, Max 4K; GPT Image 2 at most 2K). Declared without a successful live generation, by user decision.

2026-11-07 Go-key probes: the route recognises every image model id (request kind image_generations) and answers 403 tier_request_kind_not_entitled before field validation; /v1/images/edits returns 404. The plain /v1/models catalog lists image models only for entitled plans.

Reasoning levels follow each vendor's published levels by user decision instead of every label the gateway accepts: DeepSeek none/low/high/max (official DeepSeek manifest); Z.ai GLM-5.3 low/high/max with thinking always on (docs.z.ai); Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 thinking on or off only (mimo.mi.com deep thinking guide); Tencent Hy4 high or no_think only (tencent/Hy4-preview chat template); Moonshot Kimi K2.7 Code always thinking without effort control; MiniMax M3.1 Flash, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 low/medium/high/xhigh/max (official manifests), with none kept where thinking can be disabled.

Plus, Pro and Max chat models declared by user decision without live calls (a Go key cannot reach them): context, output and input modalities from the 2026-11-07 ?all=true catalog, with video input left out as on the other Chat models; protocols follow the family rule (GPT Responses, Claude Messages, others Chat). Reasoning levels follow the vendors: GPT and Claude low/medium/high/xhigh/max (official manifests), Kimi K3 low/high/max (official Kimi manifest, also used for K3.1 Pro), Gemini low/medium/high, Hy4 high or no_think (Tencent chat template). Grok 4.7 and the Muse models publish no effort control, so no effort is sent. The plain catalog shows each model only to entitled plans.
